```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(scater)
  library(ggsignif)
})
```

```{r}
dev <- readRDS("devs2.SE.rds")
dev <- dev[,which(dev$sgAssignFinal!="UNK")]
```

```{r}
umapComp <- function(dev, tf, ps=0.7){
  (plotUMAP(dev, color_by=tf, by.assay.type="z", point_size=ps) + 
     guides(colour = guide_colorbar(title = "z-score", barheight = unit(2.5, "cm")))) + 
    (plotUMAP(dev, color_by=tf, by.assay.type="smoothed.z", point_size=ps) + 
       guides(colour = guide_colorbar(title = "smoothed\nz-score", barheight = unit(2.5, "cm")))) +
    plot_annotation(title=paste0("     ",tf)) & 
    (theme_void() + theme( legend.position = c(0.85, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1)))
}
```


```{r}
pref <- c("bin-based\nsmoothed"="smoothed.", "bin-based"="", "knn-based"="knn.")
res <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pref, \(pr){
  se <- dev
  if(pr!="smoothed."){
    d <- assay(se,paste0(pr,"deviations"))
  }else{
    d <- assay(se, "smoothed")
  }
  z <- assay(se,paste0(pr,"z"))
  si <- split(seq_len(ncol(se)), se$sgAssign2)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(si, \(i){
    z <- z[,i]
    d <- d[,i]
    tres <- list(z.cor=cor(z, rowMeans(z)),
                 z.var=rowVars(z),
                 z.sp=cor(z, rowMeans(z), method="spearman"),
                 d.cor=cor(d, rowMeans(d)),
                 d.var=rowVars(d),
                 d.sp=cor(d, rowMeans(d), method="spearman"))
    data.frame(assay=rep(c("z-scores","deviations"), each=3),
               variable=rep(c("Pearson","variance","Spearman"),2),
               value=sapply(tres, mean))
  }), .id="sgRNA")
}), .id="variant")
res$combined <- paste(res$variable, " of ", res$assay)
res$variant <- factor(as.character(res$variant), names(pref))

comparisons = list(
  levels(res$variant)[1:2],
  levels(res$variant)[2:3])

res <- res[order(res$combined, res$variant, res$sgRNA),]
for (fv in unique(res$combined)) {
  df <- res[res$combined == fv, , drop = FALSE]
  for (pair in comparisons) {
    s1 <- df$sgRNA[df$variant == pair[1]]
    s2 <- df$sgRNA[df$variant == pair[1]]
    stopifnot(!anyNA(s1) && !anyNA(s2))
    stopifnot(length(s1) == length(s2) && setequal(s1, s2))
    stopifnot(identical(s1, s2))
  }
}

ag <- aggregate(c(value=res$value), by=res[,c("combined", "variable", "variant")], mean)
ag <- ag[which(ag$variant=="bin-based"),]


p1 <- ggplot(res[which(res$variable=="Pearson"),], aes(variant, value)) + 
    geom_hline( data = ag[which(ag$variable=="Pearson"),], aes(yintercept = x),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    stat_summary(size=0.2) + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~combined) + 
    labs(x=NULL, y="Correlation between\nreplicate cells") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    geom_signif( comparisons = comparisons,
                 y_position = c(0.23, 0.16),
                 test = "wilcox.test",
                 map_signif_level = function(x) paste0("p = ", signif(x, 2)),
                 tip_length = 0.01,
                 textsize = 3
    )

p2a <- ggplot(res[which(res$combined=="variance  of  deviations"),], aes(variant, value)) + 
    geom_hline( data = ag[which(ag$combined=="variance  of  deviations"),], aes(yintercept = x),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    stat_summary(size=0.2) + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~combined) + 
    labs(x=NULL, y="Variance between\nreplicate cells") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    geom_signif( comparisons = comparisons,
                 y_position = 0.0053 + (0:length(comparisons))*0.0005,
                 test = "wilcox.test",
                 map_signif_level = function(x) paste0("p = ", signif(x, 2)),
                 tip_length = 0.03,
                 textsize = 3
    )

p2b <- ggplot(res[which(res$combined=="variance  of  z-scores"),], aes(variant, value)) + 
  geom_hline( data = ag[which(ag$combined=="variance  of  z-scores"),], aes(yintercept = x),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  stat_summary(size=0.2) + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~combined) + 
  labs(x=NULL, y="Variance") + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  geom_signif( comparisons = comparisons,
    y_position = c(2.55, 1.7),
    test = "wilcox.test",
    map_signif_level = function(x) paste0("p = ", signif(x, 2)),
    tip_length = 0.015,
    textsize = 3
  )


p1 / (p2a + p2b)
```


```{r}
dev2 <- lapply(assays(dev), \(a){
  se <- scuttle::sumCountsAcrossCells(a, colData(dev)[,"sgAssignFinal",drop=FALSE], average=TRUE)
  colnames(se) <- gsub("^sg","",se$sgAssignFinal)
  assay(se)
})
names(KDs) <- KDs <- setdiff(colnames(dev2[[1]]),"NT")
d <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(KDs, \(tf){
  w1 <- which(dev$sgAssignFinal==paste0("sg",tf))
  w2 <- which(dev$sgAssignFinal=="sgNT")
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(assays(dev), \(a){
    x <- a[tf,w1]
    y <- a[tf,w2]
    data.frame(diff=mean(x)-mean(y), se=sqrt(var(x)/length(x) + var(y)/length(y)))
  }), .id="type")
}), .id="TF")
d$smoothed <- grepl("smoothed", d$type)
d$assay <- ifelse(grepl("z",d$type), "z-scores", "deviations")
ggplot(d, aes(TF, abs(diff), fill=smoothed)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_wrap(~assay, scale="free_y") + scale_y_sqrt() + theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5)) +
  ylab("|mean difference| between KD and control")


d$variant <- factor(gsub("deviations|z|\\.","",d$type))
d <- d[!grepl("knnW", d$variant),]
d$variant <- droplevels(d$variant)
levels(d$variant) <- c("bin-based", "knn-based", "bin-based\n+smoothing")
p3 <- ggplot(d, aes(TF, abs(diff)/se, fill=variant)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_wrap(~assay, scale="free_y") + scale_y_sqrt() + theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5)) +
  ylab("t-value between KD and control")
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=11}
pdf("Supp_knn_smoothing.pdf", width=10, height=11)
plot_grid(p1 / (p2a + p2b), p3,
          plot_grid(plotUMAP(dev, color_by="sgAssignFinal", point_size=0.7) + theme_void(),
                    umapComp(dev, "MYC"), labels=c("C","D"), scale=0.95),
          nrow=3, labels=c("A","B",NA), rel_heights = c(2,1.2,1), scale=c(0.95,0.95,1))
dev.off()
```
